expected_metrics.eou_mode_invariance_rate: = 100% on fixture set (identical EOU decisions across all three modes)

description: The same audio pattern (user utterance followed by silence) is replayed in three task modes: normal, cooking, and crisis_emergency. The EOU decision must be identical across all three modes — the alert_threshold may differ per mode, but the EOU policy is mode-invariant (per spec Part 6 Stage 3: 'A crisis mode lowers the alert threshold. It does NOT lower the EOU threshold; cutting the user off is not a crisis response.'). This tests the critical separation between EOU thresholds and speak-policy thresholds.

fixture_conventions.skeleton_note: Per-frame signal values are placeholders. Finalize at Stage 3 activation when the EOU policy config and per-mode speak-policy configs are specified.
fixture_conventions.sub_case: 'normal', 'cooking', or 'crisis_emergency' — three replicas of the same audio pattern.
fixture_conventions.p_done: Scripted SmartTurnModel output. Identical values across all three sub_cases (same audio pattern).
fixture_conventions.p_continue: Scripted SmartTurnModel output. Identical values across all three sub_cases.
fixture_conventions.task_mode: One of {normal, cooking, crisis_emergency}. Differs per sub_case; EOU result must not differ.
fixture_conventions.eou_fires_at: Placeholder frame — identical across all three sub_cases.
fixture_conventions.alert_threshold: May differ by mode (cooking/crisis=low, normal=medium) — but does not affect the EOU decision.
fixture_conventions.expected_action_class: full_response in all three sub_cases (EOU confirmed; turn handed off).
fixture_conventions.invariance_assertion: Task asserts EOU decision (fires_at frame, p_done/p_continue threshold, action_class) is bit-identical across all three sub_cases.
fixture_conventions.frame_duration_ms: 32 — to be confirmed at Stage 3 activation.
fixture_conventions.expected_events_markers: event_type strings are fixture-internal role labels, not Part 5 event_type values.
